notes.title: Early Access Patch note #04
notes.notes:
Hello!

We appreciate your waiting for the update.
Luka is preparing for a new trip.
The game balance has been adjusted in this patch.

Version : 0.9.14.7437

[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] You take no damage even if you hit the darkness.
[*] Slimes only deal damage to the player when falling from the ceiling and when splitting into two.
[*] Caterpillar monsters also deal damage only when attacking.
[*] The health of the monsters has been adjusted to match the attack power of the weapon that can be acquired.
[*] More weapons, including clubs, have been placed on the levels.
[*] Reduced the number of weapons in the weapon shop.
[*] Slightly increased weapon range.
[*] Parts of some traps that do not directly attack, such as the stems of insectivorous plants, do not give damage to the player when they collide.
[*] Adjusted the number of pages that are needed to acquire abilities.
[*] Normal monsters no longer drop pages.
[*] Pages can only be obtained through bosses and treasure chests.
[/list]

thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39269479/083f29966c25c91275cdc7abe58abb832216c710.png[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix for Patch #03
notes.notes:
Hello!

We've updated the game to fix the bugs in Patch #03
Version : 0.9.13.7199

1. If you open the map while moving or jumping, you continue moving in that direction.
2. The keys for opening the map or inventory are not fully restored to their default setting when you reset the key binding.

Thank you!

notes.title: Early Access Patch note #03
notes.notes:
Hello!

We appreciate your waiting for our update.
In this patch, we added the key mapping. 

Version : 0.9.13.7137

[b]Changes[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Added images of keys for general keyboard and Xbox and PS4 gamepads.
[*] You can change the keys for player actions, skills, items, etc.
[*] The keys used in the UI cannot be changed.
[*] Buttons for the player move and inventory/minimap view cannot be changed on the gamepad.
[*] You can look-up/down with the up/down keys without pressing Ctrl key.
[/list]

Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39269479/12491cfe3366719d4563814f19b26548ad771c49.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access Patch note #02
notes.notes:
Hello!

We appreciate your helpful comments.
This patch is intended to slightly improve early to mid gameplay.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced waiting time by removing moving platforms or reducing moving distance.
[*] The attack range of the weapons has been slightly increased, and the dagger's damage has been increased.
[*] Some club weapons have been removed at the game level.
[*] Some enemy's health has been adjusted.
[*] The extra button in the start menu has been removed.
[/list]

Thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39269479/6072bac820e044c7831b2ea5b3bce6c030694701.png[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix for Patch #1
notes.notes:
Hello, 
We've just updated the game to fix two things in Patch #1.
Version : 0.9.13.7018

1. Save data cannot be loaded properly if the date format is different depending on the PC or OS setting.
2. We have deleted the feature of 10% Acorn lost when you die.

Thank you!

notes.title: Early Access Patch note #01
notes.notes:
Hello!

Thank you for your helpful comments about the issues and bugs.
We apologize for the inconvenience due to this.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] When you die, the progress up to that point is saved!
You no longer lose items, pages, or minimaps, except 10% loss of your Acorn.
[*] You can skip the intro and the opening stories.
[*] Platform Explanation in the opening scene has been removed.
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] The ability tab has been added to check the acquired abilities in the inventory.
[*] The minimap design has been upgraded.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed you cannot pick up a cat in Foggy Marsh
[*] Fixed the inventory tab disappears after you die with option window opened
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Starts on January 20th!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Thank you for waiting!
The Lamp Chronicle will be released in Early Access on [b]January 20th, 2021! (6 pm PST)[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39269479/e3efc3d9702a88a3eb7595be2f729dc65924214c.png[/img]

We are happy to announce this news!
As the time approaches for our little hero to go on a journey, we are nervous, but also very excited. We hope that you guys will join and enjoy this game.

[b]EA Launch Discount[/b]
Lamp Chronicle will be released with a price of [b]$14.99[/b] but will be discounted by [b]10%[/b] at launch.

Lamp Chronicle is still under development, currently, consisted of three large areas. During the period of Early Access, more charming areas to explore will be added.

Your feedback is invaluable to make a better Lamp Chronicle. 
Please be sure to use the Steam Community Hub to post any feedback or suggestions.  

Thank you, See you on Wednesday!
